signal: Pulsora raised a $20M Series A led by Galvanize and now serves 400+ companies on its sustainability platform

email.body1:
Monit, saw Pulsora closed its $20M Series A led by Galvanize and is now in 400-plus companies.

Scaling that fast usually means more in-market ESG and sustainability buyers than the team can cover before they go cold, and that is exactly where pipeline leaks post-raise. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Pulsora off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Monit, quick follow-up for Pulsora.

Post-Series-A, board expectations on pipeline usually jump faster than headcount can ramp, and most CROs cannot say precisely how many meetings the team needs to hit the new number. The gap shows up late, and the scramble costs a quarter.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Pulsora needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Monit, last bit of proof for Pulsora.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Pulsora's reply rate likely compares to other Series-A startups. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Monit, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority right now, no problem at all. The fundraise-to-hiring stretch is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a Series-A motion? I will tailor it to Pulsora either way.
